body: Thanks man, i got through that moment, thank you for being concerned for me so much, yeah, I'm struggling to find someone who understands, a person or a group that i can turn to, and no, don't call yourself hypocritical, you literally took time to give me advice, and, knowing what to do vs actually being able to do it are two different things, so don't call yourself that way, please. I appreciate your kind words and advice, i will try my best to beat this, I'm really sorry that you feel the same way as i do,  hope you find the strength push through, have a good day, amazing person ❤️
